text:
amanda: Quick kickoff — Acadia Systems wants a 2-week integration POC. Main asks: streaming SDK, function/tool-calling, structured JSON outputs, and enterprise SSO + KMS. Can eng/devex help scope?

raj: I can lead the technical side. Who's the main Acadia contact and do we have sample traffic/latency targets?

amanda: PM is @jordan.acadia. They sent a short traffic profile: steady 50 qps, burst up to ~300 qps for ~10m windows. Target p50 gen <200ms for short prompts, p95 can be higher. Embedding batch jobs for nightly indexing too.

kevin: For streaming + function calls the recommended pattern is SSE (or websockets) + our function-call schema. SDKs (node/go/python) support streaming. Quick example for Node stream start:

```js
const r = await Redwood.stream({model: 'redwood-lite', input: '...'});
for await (const chunk of r) { console.log(chunk); }
```

kevin: For function-calling we send a JSON schema in the call and get structured tool invocations back. We'll hand off a sample repo.

sophia: Security note: Acadia flagged SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency. Hosted can do SAML for org accounts but key rotation via customer KMS requires Private/Dedicated (or a contract add-on). Need to confirm whether they require hardware-backed HSM.

amanda: Pricing question from them: they'd prefer a committed/reserved band for cost predictability. Can we sketch three bands (dev, prod, heavy) and what commit level maps to 50–300 qps?

raj: Ballpark: 50 qps steady -> small reserved pool (1-2 GPU equiv), 300 qps bursts -> recommend autoscale with a 2x reserved baseline. I'll pull model FLOP and token-rate numbers to size properly. Rough monthly commit range: $15k–$60k depending on model and quantization. Need to know which model family they plan to use.

kevin: Integration checklist I suggest we send them:
- sample app (node) with streaming + function-call example
- structured output schema example and validation harness
- handshake/credential flow (ephemeral creds example)
- perf test script (k6) with replay samples

kevin: sample structured-output hint: set `output_schema` and run local `schema-validate` in the SDK before sending.

legal-bot: Acadia_Security_Questionnaire.pdf uploaded to /legal/incoming (link). Please assign owners for SSO and KMS responses.

amanda: Action items: raj -> runbook + sizing calc by EOD Wed (1733410000). kevin -> sample repo + streaming demo by tomorrow noon. sophia -> confirm SSO/KMS required work and EU residency feasibility; list blockers. I'll coordinate dates with Acadia and share pricing bands.

raj: ack, I'll start with model options and perf assumptions.

kevin: will create the repo and paste a short README with handshake flow.

sophia: noted — I'll check HSM requirements and whether a dedicated Private pilot is needed.

amanda: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll ping @jordan.acadia for kickoff calendar invites once we have the runbook draft.

raj: one more ask — do we have any existing customers with similar footprint I can reference for latency/cost numbers?

kevin: yes — share anonymized ranges from retail bot pilot. I'll DM the numbers.

amanda: closing loop here, convo will continue in the runbook thread once items are posted.
